transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, I'm Tess. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hi Tess. The TV box in my bedroom keeps losing the signal every evening, which is when I actually want to watch it. I'm getting fed up.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Losing the TV right when you want to watch it is really annoying, I'm sorry, Lorcan. Let's fix it. Can I take your PIN?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks. So the bedroom TV box loses its signal every evening. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is it the box in the bedroom or the living room?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The bedroom, upstairs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is it on wifi or plugged in?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Wifi.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Sorry, yes. Which room is the box in again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The bedroom. Upstairs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And it's on wifi, not a cable?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, wifi, I just said.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Are you still there?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes. In the evening the wifi is busiest. I've switched your router to a less crowded channel. Can you put the TV on now and leave it on a channel for a couple of minutes?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay. It's on. It's playing fine, no dropping so far.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Still fine.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great, so the box is holding the signal now. Is that working for you?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it's working.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Cheers, bye.
